description: DeFi yield API: current APY for stablecoin and DeFi pools in one GET, no parameters. Returns JSON: up to 25 pools ordered by a fixed filter tier then APY, each with project, chain, symbol, tvlUsd, apy, apyBase, apyReward, apyMean30d, stablecoin, exposure, ilRisk and poolId. Filters: TVL >= $10M, non-outlier APY. Figures passed through from DefiLlama at fetch time, not advice. Errors are not charged. Price $0.02 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Data changes about every 1 h; calling more often returns the same values.
name: yield
